headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: TON documentation spans 465 crawled pages with 100% crawl coverage and zero confirmed broken links. API reference coverage stands at 64.09% across 136 detected API pages, leaving over one-third of API surface undocumented. SEO/geo issues affect 22.37% of pages, risking organic discovery and regional reach. Retrieval readiness scores 82.85/100 (strong band), with 90.09% of 1,463 key claims backed by evidence. Overall audit confidence is 63.5%, constrained by link verification limitations (8 unverified URLs due to auth/rate-limit blocks).

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

priority_actions.title: Close the 35.91% API documentation gap by generating usage examples and parameter guides for the 49 undocumented API pages (out of 136 detected)
priority_actions.why_this_first: Undocumented APIs block developer onboarding and integration velocity, directly reducing time-to-first-transaction and increasing support load for missing endpoint guidance.

priority_actions.title: Remediate SEO/geo issues on the 104 affected pages (22.37% of 465) by adding missing meta descriptions, fixing duplicate titles, and ensuring regional hreflang tags
priority_actions.why_this_first: SEO fixes unlock organic search traffic and regional discoverability, expanding top-of-funnel developer acquisition with minimal engineering dependency.

priority_actions.title: Improve answerability for the 82 pages (17.63%) failing LLM-readiness checks by adding explicit Q&A pairs, summary sections, or structured how-to blocks
priority_actions.why_this_first: Answerability gaps degrade performance in AI-powered search and chatbots, reducing self-service success and increasing support ticket volume as LLM adoption grows.

strengths: 100% crawl coverage (465 of 473 in-scope pages) with zero broken internal or repository navigation links
99.57% of pages include last-updated metadata, supporting freshness transparency
90.09% of 1,463 detected claims are backed by evidence, strengthening trust and AI answer quality
risks: 35.91% of API surface lacks usage documentation (136 API pages detected, 64.09% coverage), blocking developer onboarding for uncovered endpoints
22.37% SEO/geo issue rate threatens organic search visibility and regional discoverability, directly impacting inbound developer acquisition
8 unverified links (auth/rate-limit/server blocks) introduce unknown broken-link exposure; link confidence is only 25%
17.63% of pages fail answerability checks, limiting effectiveness in LLM-powered search and chatbot contexts
limitations: External audit cannot verify the 8 auth/rate-limit-blocked URLs; actual broken-link count may be higher than zero, and link confidence remains at 25%.
API detection relies on heuristic pattern matching; no_api_pages_found is false, but edge-case endpoints (e.g., webhooks, admin APIs) may be undercounted in the 136-page total.
Freshness metadata (99.57% coverage) reflects presence of last-updated fields, not accuracy; pages may be marked current despite outdated content.
automation_first: Deploy automated SEO linter in CI/CD to flag missing meta descriptions, duplicate titles, and hreflang gaps on every commit, preventing recurrence of the 22.37% issue rate and ensuring new pages launch search-optimized.

Implement nightly API schema diff scanner to detect new or changed endpoints not yet documented, auto-filing GitHub issues for the 49 undocumented APIs and preventing future coverage drift below the current 64.09%.

Add pre-commit answerability and chunkability checks using LLM-based scoring to block merges of pages failing the 17.63% answerability threshold, reducing support load and improving RAG retrieval quality at authoring time.
